À chaque analyse, chaque archive lue san:
On each analysis, every archive read without problems (ZIP, RAR, 7z, TAR, GZ…) will be extracted into a new folder named after it, next to it. Each extracted file is verified by its fingerprint; the archive then goes to the Mac Trash (recoverable), only if everything is verified. Password-protected, damaged or booby-trapped archives are never touched.
